children: Paladin launched a fully underwritten equity raising of A$525M: an A$474M ASX placement and a C$50M bought deal, approximately A$51M. It also plans a non-underwritten share purchase plan to raise up to a further A$50M.
The issuance adds substantial new shares and may dilute existing holders; the release gives no prior-period comparison.
A$474M placement at A$7.80 per share
The price is a 10.3% discount to the prior ASX close of A$8.70, a near-term pricing and dilution overhang.
Underwriters agreed to purchase the shares; closing remains subject to conditions, including TSX approval.
SPP targets up to a further A$50M
This additional, non-underwritten offer could increase dilution, but the amount raised is not assured.
Funds to advance PLS, Triple R and exploration
Proceeds support project development, potential resource growth and mine-life extension, and Athabasca Basin exploration.

This is a financing event to fund Paladin’s stated project-development and exploration plans, rather than a report of completed project milestones. Investors will look for completion of the placements and SPP, disclosure of final proceeds and uses, and progress toward the stated PLS production target in 2031.
from Paladin Energy Ltd distributed by GlobeNewswire.
